nodes.long_description:
### Step inside the music.

Sound Voyages VR turns each piece of music into a place you can stand in. Pick a voyage and the world wraps around you in 360°: neon night drives, deep space, ocean abysses, ancient shrines, dance floors and storms. Every voyage is original music by iKRX, made for 360° video and streamed at full quality — up to 8K at 60 fps, without the compression of video sites.

### A new voyage every week
Over 120 immersive voyages already, and a new one every week. Collections: Serenity Vibes, Night Drive, Space Voyages, Cyberpunk Dreams, Cinematic VR Adventures and more.

### Whatever mood you are in
Ambient and downtempo to relax, meditate or fall asleep to. Techno and groove to move to. Dark and cinematic when you want an edge.

### Made to sit back
- Sleep timer that fades picture and sound out gently
- Loop a voyage, or let the list play on
- Keep watching: pick up where you left off
- Favourites you can move to another headset with a code
- Subtitles and interface in English and Spanish

### Simple on purpose
No ads, no accounts, no purchases. One email to enter; news only if you ask.

Streaming notice: voyages stream from our own servers, so a good internet connection is required. The streamed content is provided by Zigra Servicios Profesionales SL and may not be available in perpetuity.

Health notice: some voyages contain flashing lights and fast camera motion. Take breaks if you are sensitive to either.

soundvoyagesvr.com · Support: info@zigra.net
nodes.short_description: Step inside the music. A free library of 120+ immersive 360° video music voyages — with a brand new voyage every week. Drift through neon night drives, deep space, ocean abysses, ancient shrines and dance floors, streamed to your headset at up to 8K and 60 fps. Made to relax, meditate or fall asleep to, and just as good turned up loud. Over 1.2 million views on YouTube. No ads, no accounts, no purchases.

nodes.change_log:
What’s new in 2.0
• Tablet mode: hold the menu in your hands like a tablet. Grab it by its edges, move it anywhere, and toss it back when you’re done.
• Touch it directly: tap with your index finger or thumb, and swipe the shelves and the menu with your finger.
• Video controls you can touch, with a 3D volume slider.
• Hold the arrows to keep scrolling; shelves snap neatly into place.
• Move the menu by grabbing its title bar, like any Meta window.
• A short practice shows you the new gestures the first time.
• A smooth fade when you close the app.
• Use the app with your hands only, no controllers needed. A short gesture guide shows you how (tap ? anytime).
• Look and pinch: aim with your gaze and pinch to select.
• My ♥ Voyages: all your favourites in one list, with Play all.
• History: every voyage you've watched or started, with your progress. Continue where you left off or start over.
• ★ Selected Voyages: our hand-picked collection, now first in the menu.
• Up next, and a countdown to the next premiere.
• Views and likes from all our platforms on every voyage.
• Hold a pinch to bring the menu in front of you.
• During a voyage, the back gesture with the controls in view takes you back to where you were in the menu.
